# oxide_vpc_firewall_rules (Data Source)

Retrieve the firewall rules associated with a VPC.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "oxide_vpc_firewall_rules" "example" {
  project = "my-project"
  vpc     = "my-vpc"

  timeouts = {
    read = "1m"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) Name or ID of the project that contains the VPC.
- `vpc` (String) Name or ID of the VPC.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `rules` (Attributes Set) Firewall rules associated with the VPC. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) Whether traffic matching the rule is allowed or denied.
- `description` (String) Description for the VPC firewall rule.
- `direction` (String) Whether the rule applies to inbound or outbound traffic.
- `filters` (Attributes) Reductions on the scope of the rule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--filters))
- `id` (String) Unique, immutable, system-controlled identifier of the firewall rule.
- `name` (String) Name of the VPC firewall rule.
- `priority` (Number) Relative priority of the rule.
- `status` (String) Whether the rule is enabled or disabled.
- `targets` (Attributes Set) Sets of instances to which the rule applies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--targets))
- `time_created` (String) Timestamp of when the firewall rule was created.
- `time_modified` (String) Timestamp of when the firewall rule was last modified.
- `vpc_id` (String) ID of the VPC to which the rule belongs.

<a id="nestedatt--rules--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.filters`

Read-Only:

- `hosts` (Attributes Set) Sources or destinations to which the rule applies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--filters--hosts))
- `ports` (Set of String) Destination ports or port ranges to which the rule applies.
- `protocols` (Attributes Set) Networking protocols to which the rule applies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--filters--protocols))

<a id="nestedatt--rules--filters--hosts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.filters.hosts`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Host filter type.
- `value` (String) Host filter value.


<a id="nestedatt--rules--filters--protocols"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.filters.protocols`

Read-Only:

- `icmp_code` (String) ICMP code or code range.
- `icmp_type` (Number) ICMP type.
- `type` (String) Protocol type.



<a id="nestedatt--rules--targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.targets`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Target type.
- `value` (String) Target value.
